name: pictochat-mvp
description: Chat efimero de texto, dibujo y archivos para web, Android e iOS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pictochat/shared && npm run build -w @pictochat/server && npm run build -w @pictochat/client
scripts.build:pwa: npm run build -w @pictochat/shared && npm run build -w @pictochat/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pictochat/shared && npm run test -w @pictochat/server && npm run test -w @pictochat/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pictochat/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pictochat/server && npm run typecheck -w @pictochat/client
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/client/dist apps/server/dist packages/shared/dist apps/client/coverage apps/server/coverage apps/client/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/server/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/server/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo packages/shared/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/shared/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:pwa && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap sync && npm run native:configure && npm run assets:generate -w @pictochat/client
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:pwa && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap add android && npm run native:configure && npm run assets:generate:android -w @pictochat/client && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap sync android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:pwa && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap add ios -- --packagemanager CocoaPods && npm run native:configure && npm run assets:generate:ios -w @pictochat/client && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npm exec -w @pictochat/client cap open ios
